body:
#: 17
Decision: Pets learn tricks, with training gear per pet type
Notes: Pets start with 1 trick and learn more by practising with you in the pet yard; at the show they only do tricks they know, and practised tricks have a bigger gold zone. Each pet type trains on its own gear (new models), e.g. dogs an agility course, snakes dance to a flute
title: Pet decision 17: Pets learn tricks, with training gear per pet type
